name: Beast King Warrior God DANDIVINE
original_name: 獣王武神ダンデヴァイン
overview: The series takes place 20 years after the legendary combining robot DANDIVINE defeated the mysterious enemy known as the Aposdolls. In the present day, the robot has become little more than a nostalgic memory, while the toy manufacturer that once built its popularity struggles to stay afloat.
